basics.name: Olli Rantasalo
basics.label: Principal Product Engineer and Architect, Partner
basics.summary:
Olli is a Product Engineer and hands-on Architect with over 20 years of experience delivering digital services that solve real-world problems. He helps teams turn ideas into working software, from quick prototypes to scalable cloud platforms.

He focuses on building products that are useful, reliable, and maintainable. Olli has led projects across industries. He works fluently with both technical and business stakeholders, always aiming to build the right thing, not just build it well.

He cares about outcomes and takes pride in shipping products that create real value.

Olli sees AI as a practical tool for solving real problems, not just a trend. While foundation models have opened new possibilities, he believes there's still a lot of untapped potential in more traditional AI and Machine Learning methods, especially when paired with domain knowledge and solid engineering. For Olli, the focus is always on using the right approach to create value, not chasing hype.

Olli blends deep technical expertise with a strong product mindset. As a Product Engineer, Solution Architect, and Technical Lead, he helps teams build software that delivers real value, from concept to production.
basics.x-tagline: Meaningful results depend on how data is handled from the very beginning: reliable insight only appears when quality, structure and governance are designed in from the start instead of being bolted on later.

x-keyRoles.title: Product Engineer
x-keyRoles.description: Drives the development of scalable and maintainable digital products by aligning user needs, business goals, and technical execution. Balances hands-on coding with product thinking to deliver real value.

x-keyRoles.title: Solution Architect
x-keyRoles.description: Designs robust software architectures that support long-term product growth. Translates complex requirements into clear technical strategies that teams can execute efficiently.

x-keyRoles.title: Technical Lead
x-keyRoles.description: Leads cross-functional teams through all stages of product development. Ensures quality, fosters collaboration, and keeps projects on track by combining technical guidance with clear communication.

x-keySkills.title: Team Leadership
x-keySkills.description: Guides cross-functional teams with clarity and purpose, focusing on collaboration, accountability, and growth.

x-keySkills.title: Stakeholder Communication
x-keySkills.description: Enables clear communication between technical detail and business goals, ensuring alignment and shared understanding across roles.

x-keySkills.title: Mentoring & Coaching
x-keySkills.description: Supports individual growth through hands-on guidance, knowledge sharing, and a culture of continuous learning.

x-keySkills.title: Strategic Thinking
x-keySkills.description: Sees the big picture by connecting product direction, architecture, and delivery to long-term business outcomes.

x-keySkills.title: Problem Solving
x-keySkills.description: Tackles complexity with a pragmatic mindset by breaking down challenges and focusing on actionable solutions.
